"""Read exact Git/source/cache identities and retained historical records only."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

E = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
R = E.parent / 'sifr'
H = Path('/private/tmp/sifr-b42-host.FVuvOb')
out = {'git_reads': [], 'newly_bound_saved_files': {}, 'history': {}}

def read(path, expected=None):
    path = Path(path)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if expected is not None and digest != expected:
        raise ValueError(f'Hash mismatch: {path}')
    out['newly_bound_saved_files'][str(path)] = {
        'sha256': digest, 'bytes': len(data), 'mtime_ns': path.stat().st_mtime_ns,
        'prior_seal_authenticated': expected is not None}
    return data

def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=R, capture_output=True, check=True)
    out['git_reads'].append({'argv': ['git', *args], 'cwd': str(R),
                             'exit_code': result.returncode,
                             'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest()})
    return result.stdout

revs = {
    'main': '4b4cc339964baeeb6641e57dc669fef700a5fa24',
    'failed': '4a867cbde6d83e56ec7b66ca32887388dfa42803',
    'B13': '98480c78587d6cbd99a7079d10c71825360bd468',
    'B19_measurement_source': '3181cc6dcd4bed372d6aa3291cc30ececc2f5538',
    'B19_reviewed': '711b5a424cf9f2473f07693b3706f23b14587ba1',
    'B20': 'ac4c277b30c6cac046ab1746fe4020c04df7eaf1',
}
paths = [
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/stdlib/bootstrap.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/stdlib/interop.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/stdlib/types.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/sysroot_interop.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/entrypoint.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/single_file_interop_cache.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop/probe_planning.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop_probe.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop_probe_cache.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop_probe_paths.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop_probe_manifest.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop_probe_features.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop_probe_nonce.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop_probe_policy.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/rust_interop_digest.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/cargo_resolution.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/workspace.rs',
    'crates/sifr_driver/src/build/project_codegen.rs',
    'crates/sifr_codegen/src/rust_interop_plan.rs',
    'crates/sifr_codegen/src/lib_project_codegen.rs',
    'crates/sifr_stdlib/Cargo.toml', 'crates/sifr_runtime/Cargo.toml',
    'demos/additional_modules/main.sifr', 'sifr.toml', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock',
    'rust-toolchain.toml', 'verification/areas/performance/run_benchmarks.py',
    'verification/areas/performance/benchmark_process.py',
    'verification/areas/performance/data/benchmark_manifest.json',
    'verification/areas/performance/data/work_budgets.json',
]
matrix = {}
for path in paths:
    row = {}
    for label, sha in revs.items():
        listing = git('ls-tree', sha, '--', path).decode().strip()
        if not listing:
            row[label] = None
            continue
        blob = listing.split()[2]
        data = git('cat-file', 'blob', blob)
        row[label] = {'blob': blob, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                      'bytes': len(data)}
        if label == 'failed':
            retained = read(H / 'sifr' / path)
            if retained != data:
                raise ValueError(f'Retained failed source differs: {path}')
    matrix[path] = row
out['revisions'] = revs
out['source_matrix'] = matrix
out['main_to_failed_paths'] = git('diff', '--name-only', revs['main'], revs['failed']).decode().splitlines()
out['remote_main'] = git('ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/main').decode().strip()

# Saved import closure, lexical source inventory only; not a new compiler run.
queue = [('entry', R / 'demos/additional_modules/main.sifr')]
imports = {}
while queue:
    name, path = queue.pop()
    if name in imports:
        continue
    source = read(path).decode()
    deps = sorted(set(re.findall(r'^from\s+((?:_sifr|sifr)\.[\w.]+)\s+import', source, re.M)))
    imports[name] = {'path': str(path), 'imports': deps}
    for dep in deps:
        queue.append((dep, R / 'stdlib' / (dep.replace('.', '/') + '.sifr')))
out['lexical_import_closure'] = imports

cache_files = [H / 'sifr/target/.rustc_info.json',
               H / 'tmp/sifr_generated_artifact_cache/rust_bridge_probe_target/.rustc_info.json']
out['toolchain_cache_metadata'] = {str(p): json.loads(read(p)) for p in cache_files}
out['prepared_locks'] = []
for p in sorted((H / 'tmp/sifr_generated_artifact_cache/cargo_resolution').glob('*/Cargo.lock')):
    data = read(p)
    lock = tomllib.loads(data.decode())
    out['prepared_locks'].append({'path': str(p), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                                  'package_count': len(lock['package']),
                                  'pyo3': [x for x in lock['package'] if x['name'].startswith('pyo3')]})
out['fingerprint_metadata'] = []
target = H / 'tmp/sifr_generated_artifact_cache/rust_bridge_probe_target/debug/.fingerprint'
for pattern in ['sifr_runtime-*/lib-sifr_runtime.json', 'sifr_stdlib-*/lib-sifr_stdlib.json',
                'sifr-rust-probe-*/lib-sifr_rust_probe.json', 'pyo3-build-config-*/*.json']:
    for p in sorted(target.glob(pattern)):
        out['fingerprint_metadata'].append({'path': str(p), 'data': json.loads(read(p))})

b19 = json.loads((E / 'saved-analysis.json').read_text())
mapping = json.loads(read('/private/tmp/sifr-b19.udje7q/evidence/input-map.3181cc6dc.json',
                         b19['bound']['/private/tmp/sifr-b19.udje7q/evidence/input-map.3181cc6dc.json']['sha256']))
old_rows = []
for item in mapping['preservation_maps']:
    inventory = json.loads(read(item['path'], item['sha256']))
    for row in inventory:
        name = row['original']
        if ('performance' in name and
            (name.endswith('Cargo.toml') or name.endswith('Cargo.lock') or
             ('build-project-001' in name and name.endswith('.json')) or
             'performance-merge-results.json' in name)):
            data = read(row['preserved'], row['sha256'])
            old_rows.append(row | {'content': data.decode()})
out['history']['B13_preserved_relevant'] = old_rows
out['history']['B19_build_receipts'] = [p for p in b19['bound'] if p.startswith('/private/tmp/sifr-b19.udje7q/') and 'build-project' in p]
b20 = json.loads(read('/private/tmp/sifr-b20.bj6Au6/evidence/terminal.json',
                     '0b4fe5b32beb604527091fdfbeab9ff3b4b7dbd6d4d194e27ebb17d3260999dc'))
inventory = json.loads(read(b20['inventory_path'], b20['inventory_sha256']))
b20_rows = []
for row in inventory['artifacts']:
    if any(s in row['path'] for s in ['qualification', 'stopped-process', 'representative']):
        path = Path(inventory['root']) / row['path']
        data = read(path, row['sha256'])
        b20_rows.append(row | {'path': str(path), 'content': data.decode(errors='replace')})
out['history']['B20_relevant'] = b20_rows
(E / 'source-crosswalk.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2) + '\n')
print('source_paths', len(matrix), 'revisions', len(revs), 'import_closure', sorted(imports))
print('prepared_locks', len(out['prepared_locks']), 'fingerprints', len(out['fingerprint_metadata']))
print('B13_relevant_rows', len(old_rows), 'B19_build_receipts', out['history']['B19_build_receipts'],
      'B20_relevant_rows', len(b20_rows))
print('core_source_differences_B13_main', [p for p, r in matrix.items() if r['B13'] != r['main']])

"""Extract bounded remaining facts from saved files; no live diagnostics."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

E = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
H = Path('/private/tmp/sifr-b42-host.FVuvOb')
out = {'authenticated': {}, 'observed_process_starts': []}

def read(path, expected):
    path = Path(path)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if digest != expected:
        raise ValueError(f'Hash mismatch: {path}')
    out['authenticated'][str(path)] = {'sha256': digest, 'bytes': len(data)}
    return data

read(H / 'sifr/target/debug/sifr', 'ba05221d463c08e8c4ca2f1a5001e6d0088ef705d0eb1a09896ee0a23028c293')
read(H / 'sifr/target/debug/frontend_query_bench', '6c5e9793e16c50ad73115b181c4aaababfbc1845a9127e0a5091d722c4a3e4fc')
root = Path('/private/tmp/sifr-b13-integration.oBoJJW')
gate = json.loads(read(root / 'gate-outcome.98480c78587d6cbd99a7079d10c71825360bd468.json',
                      '57415124d13a0c6429e4e4020d7544235bf5b7fbb1bd3830364b57527b2d2235'))
read(gate['gate_receipt'], gate['gate_receipt_sha256'])
log = read(gate['log'], gate['log_sha256']).decode()
out['B13'] = {
    'production_setup': gate['production_setup'],
    'freshness': next(x for x in gate['guards'] if x['id'] == 'demo-emitted-freshness'),
    'selected_log_lines': [{'line': i, 'text': line} for i, line in enumerate(log.splitlines(), 1)
                           if any(s in line for s in ['build-project-001', 'build-singlefile-001',
                                                       'check-project-001', 'check-singlefile-001',
                                                       'diagnostic-check-001'])],
    'limit': 'Case aggregate timings are not raw warmup durations or a before-first-use cache inventory.'}
receipt = json.loads(read(H / 'evidence/representative-01.json',
                         'c7cae91614fb98c68a74571c6fad8c7ba677db004ddfc5d0de3b207b8f4c0e94'))
selected = {33590, 33598, 33658, 33833, 33884, 33900, 34105, 34742,
            38218, 45012, 46161, 49548, 52340, 52417}
out['observed_process_starts'] = [p for p in receipt['observed_processes'] if p['pid'] in selected]
artifact = H / 'sifr/target/performance/bench-1788876840-33516/attempts/1/artifacts/build-project-001-additional-modules'
out['retained_build_artifact_metadata'] = {
    'root': str(artifact), 'exists_at_B43_read': artifact.exists(),
    'files_at_B43_read': [str(p) for p in sorted(artifact.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()],
    'custody': 'B43 read-only retained filesystem observation, not a historical start/end snapshot.'}
(E / 'final-saved-facts.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'authenticated_files': len(out['authenticated']), 'B13': out['B13'],
                  'starts': [{k: p[k] for k in ['pid', 'ppid', 'start']} for p in out['observed_process_starts']],
                  'artifacts': out['retained_build_artifact_metadata']}, indent=2))
